events.summary: Hey everyone,We just hit 100 Wishlists for No Witnesses!It might sound like a small milestone to some, but as indie devs, seeing the first 100 people hit that button means the world to us. Knowing there's an actual community out there excited to see where this game goes keeps us going.A huge thank you to everyone who wishlisted, requested playtest access, reported bugs, or just hung out in the Discord.
